note: Carpio city park at the east edge of town (Ward County): grassy sites with no pads at electric posts, beside a playground, basketball court and picnic shelter. Campers recommend smaller rigs (drive onto the grass; two spots allow pulling alongside); a 23-ft rig should fit. Frequent train noise from the rail line through town. The city has no web page; the rate is camper-reported ($15 a night by an easy-pay option, June 2025), and campers in 2018, 2020 and 2025 found the water off. --Claude
summary: No operator page exists (city has no website; ND Tourism 403 unread). Camper reports 2025: $15 a night, 3-night max, ~5 30-amp posts on grass, water off, pit toilets.
